extracted.name: Slow Cooker Swiss Steak
extracted.description: This crockpot Swiss steak features browned beef simmered in a slow cooker with vegetables, seasonings, and tomato juice for a tender, flavorful dish.
ingredient_lines: 1.5 pounds round steak, cut into small pieces
2 (14.5 ounce) cans diced tomatoes with juice
2 tablespoons brown sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: Mix together flour, salt, and pepper in a shallow bowl. Dredge steak pieces in flour mixture to lightly coat.

Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir celery, onion, and carrots in hot oil until tender, about 5 minutes. Add coated steak pieces; cook and stir until lightly browned, about 5 minutes more.
Transfer steak-vegetable mixture to the slow cooker. Stir in tomatoes with juice, brown sugar, and Worcestershire sauce.
Cover and cook on Low until steak is very tender, 8 to 10 hours.
